fix_commit_message:
[float16array] Fix lastIndexOf

When special casing 0 in Float16Array lastIndexOf, do the search after
accounting for user code resizing the buffer.

agent_reasoning: Merged diff composed mechanically by cherry-picking fix 3e097c3eb753 on top of intro 81c947baca3b via git's 3-way merge. Vulnerability (OutOfBoundsRead):  Root cause: When adding the Float16 0-equality special case in `LastIndexOfValueImpl`, the author placed the new branch in the same `else if` chain used to handle NaN/Infinity before the `ToTypedSearchValue` call, and before the post-conversion bounds re-check block (`start_from >= typed_array_length`). This means the Float16 zero path exits early using a potentially-stale `start_from` that was derived from user-observable JS (the `fromIndex` argument's `ToInteger` conversion), without accounting for RAB resizing side effects that may have occurred during that conversion.
